purpose: Bounded attempt to improve the existing HMM expert selector through persistent positions and turnover-aware costs.
selection_rule: Require positive validation net return and at least 20% ticker-interval coverage; rank eligible candidates by net return, then Sharpe, then lower turnover. Freeze winner before reserved-period scoring. No reserved-period retuning.
stop_rule: Run these six designs once. If none qualifies, record the failure and move to a separately specified HMM strategy hypothesis. A negative reserved result remains a negative result.
period_caveat: 2018-2025 data were used in earlier research. 2026 data and cash-fallback reports were previously accessed; 2026 is reserved for selection within this attempt, not a pristine never-seen holdout.
benchmark_scope: An equal-weight buy-and-hold benchmark on the same three stocks. Russell 3000 and the supplied expanded universe are deferred until a model passes the positive-trading research check.
